text: The badger is a symbolic animal in Celtic mythology. It was seen as a shape-shifting person, much like the seal. The Irish hero Tadg found badger meat revolting. He did not understand why it disgusted him. The truth is that the badgers were his own kin. Their power to change form tied them to him. He shunned them without knowing of the bond.
